scientific_integrity: All mathematical assertions follow from a finite complete residue argument and explicit divisibility witnesses. Source priority and chronology are as stated in the references; no independent review or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary positive base-3 integers, product of nonzero ternary digits, and fixed difference 2; does not determine other step/base pairs or all extremizers. Seven residue classes modulo 108 give the infinite upper bound, and one explicit 13-term progression with infinitely many carries-free high-digit shifts supplies equality. Reproducible finite checks are corroborative, not a substitute for proof. Potential unindexed equivalent prior results remain possible.
title: The sharp step-two bound for ternary prodigious numbers
